name: Signal Integrity
description: IBIS-based reflection and crosstalk simulation of routed nets. Each segment's impedance, delay and loss come from Waffle's 2D field solver for its cross-section; vias are lumped with stubs after back-drilling; series and shunt parts and IBIS package parasitics are included. Typ/min/max corners, overshoot, ringback, settling, flight time and monotonicity, NEXT/FEXT on neighbouring nets and series/parallel termination sweeps. Runs offline in the sandbox; IBIS files and model assignments are stored in the project only through reviewed proposals.
